title: Nasty ModMate – Peach Lemonade 50ml Shortfill
description:
Nasty ModMate Peach Lemonade is a mix of sweet and citrus flavours. A refreshing sweet peach is present on each inhale and zingy lemonade notes on exhale to create a balanced vape that’s bursting with flavour.
Peach Lemonade by Nasty Juice comes in 50ml bottles with 10ml space to add in your nicotine shot, with 70% VG you can use this liquid in any sub-ohm device.
ModMate by Nasty is a specially formulated Free base solution that’s fine-tuned for optimised performance with all leading Mod devices.
Bottle Size:
60ml
Nicotine Strength:
0mg
VG/PG
70% / 30%
